name: Asmara: A Modernist African City
description: Asmara, Eritrea's capital, sits on a highland plateau more than 2,300 metres above sea level. Most of its streets were laid out by Italian colonisers between the 1890s and 1941, and today they are lined with sleek rationalist cinemas, hotels, churches, mosques and a synagogue. Nicknamed "Little Rome," it feels like an open-air museum of early modernist design in Africa.
